channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Darius Bazley | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Darius Bazley from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Darius Bazley
item.description:
Brandon Rahbar:Mark Daigneault on SGA and Bazley’s availability tomorrow vs the Grizz:

“All I know is those injuries are not long term things. They’re closer to playing than they are to sitting out.”

Mark Daigneault on Darius Bazley, Mar 13, 2021. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Darius Bazley
item.description:
Brandon Rahbar:Mark Daigneault on Darius Bazley's development ups and downs, says you can't evaluate minute by minute:

“Is he a better player than when we drafted him? Yes. Is he a better player than he was last year? Absolutely. Is he a better player than he was the first 10 games? Yes he is.”

Mark Daigneault on Darius Bazley, Mar 4, 2021. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Darius Bazley
item.description:
Brandon Rahbar:Mark Daigneault on Darius Bazley:

“Our scout coach asked each player to break down their opponent. I was really impressed by Baze, Lu and Shai’s understanding.”

Mark Daigneault on Darius Bazley, Dec 16, 2020. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Darius Bazley
item.description:
Brandon Rahbar:Mark Daigneault on Darius Bazley expectations:

“He's a young enough player that his game is a little undefined and we're a bit in discovery mode with him. We're gonna see where his game takes him.”

Mark Daigneault on Darius Bazley, Dec 7, 2020. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Darius Bazley
item.description:
Billy Donovan on Darius Bazley:

“I feel very confident about him out there. Darius because of his basketball IQ, we want to give him an opportunity to go out and help our team.”

Billy Donovan on Darius Bazley, Sep 1, 2020. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Darius Bazley, Luguentz Dort
item.description:
Donovan on Shai, Bazley and Dort:

“The majority of our team is young. For three young guys on our team, the experience from this year is going to make them better players going forward.”

Billy Donovan on Darius Bazley, Luguentz Dort, Sep 1, 2020. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Chris Paul on Darius Bazley
item.description:
Brandon Rahbar:Chris Paul on Darius Bazley being with him in the players meeting:

“Baze is like a little brother to me. It was dope to be able to do all those different things with him.”

Chris Paul on Darius Bazley, Aug 30, 2020. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Chris Paul on Darius Bazley
item.description:
Paul, the president of the National Basketball Players Association, says players now have a role to play in getting fans to vote.

“I was talking to Darius Bazley, one of my teammates, about voting the other day so understanding how powerful our voice is to get people to get out and vote,”

Chris Paul on Darius Bazley, Aug 19, 2020. Source: KYMA.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Darius Bazley
item.description:
Billy Donovan on going small with Darius Bazley:

“I’m not opposed to that at all. It’s not about downsizing. Certainly we have the flexibility. We have to have a level of rim protection and physicality. But I do feel comfortable playing Muscala and Darius at the 5.”

Billy Donovan on Darius Bazley, Aug 18, 2020. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Danilo Gallinari, Darius Bazley
item.description:
Erik Horne:Donovan on Darius Bazley’s opportunity with Danilo Gallinari out:

“He’s gonna have to go through some of this stuff in order to learn, grow. There’s going to be some ups and downs but the biggest thing for me is he’s competing and playing with really good energy and motor.”

Billy Donovan on Danilo Gallinari, Darius Bazley, Dec 26, 2019. Source: Twitter @ErikHorneOK.
